captions.head: Clear glass turns green
captions.sub: Selenium was hiding the iron tint.

captions.head: Cadmium red turns yellow
captions.sub: Without selenium it is cadmium sulfide.

captions.head: Solar facades drop to 0 W
captions.sub: Half the atoms in a CIGS cell are selenium.

captions.head: Screens turn blue
captions.sub: Their red and green come from cadmium selenide dots.

captions.head: 25 of your proteins stall
captions.sub: Each one is built around selenium.

captions.head: Selenium is back
captions.sub: Five seconds is too short for your body to notice.
